## 758360aea29b

**Reproduced defect; target left unchanged.** The drawn source is SHA-256
`5eca5d902b2092d002106741ff5d69c74f1e3f14f6b585534de6a2a86a854433`.
Strict audit defect lint exited 1 with one blocking issue and 112 warnings. The
blocking issue is that `AXES["texture"].valid` includes the negative fixtures
`full_grid`, `no_objects`, and `single_object` in the ordinary valid domain.
The same report records 107 accepted invalid scalar probes, four dead helpful
textures, one behavior-equivalent rule-source divergence, and no `RULE_HASH`
pin.

A separate contract probe at seed 991/sample index 0 confirmed that `warm` and
`palette_kind="warm"` are byte-identical to the default draw; advertised
`texture="no_objects"` is accepted but fails `self_check`; `unknown_axis=1`,
`n_objects=2.75`, and `seed=True` are accepted. This is a call/domain finding,
not a label-semantics claim. Evidence:
`checks/audit/758360aea29b/defect/checks/758360aea29b_audit_defect_lint.log` and
`checks/audit/758360aea29b/contract_findings.json`. No source file for this audit
target was edited.
